g.title: Any HTTP or gRPC service, local or remote.
Pass or fail per request, per check and per data row, with timings. The exit code fails the CI job when any check fails.
A Gostman folder, a Postman or Bruno export, or an OpenAPI file, loaded by one bounded pool of readers sized at twice the CPU count.
Each row becomes one iteration with its own variables, so one collection tests many inputs. Rows with French and Japanese titles run unchanged.
Resolves folder filters, tags, --only, iterations and --parallel into an ordered list of executions before anything is sent.
Sends the request, follows redirects, keeps cookies per run and applies extract rules so later requests can reuse values from earlier responses.

Pre-request and test scripts run in goja, a JavaScript engine written in Go, with the Postman pm and Bruno bru APIs. Every script gets a runtime no other script has touched; up to four are booted ahead of time.
